basic.name: Basic
basic.description: Better Adventures+ server mods, ships, smooth decks, lighter snow, Sodium and client performance mods. Runs on almost any PC.

full.name: Full
full.description: Everything in Basic plus the Better Adventures+ client mods, Iris with Complementary and Miniature shaders, full snow and ships.

recommended.name: Recommended
recommended.description: Full kit when this PC can take it; otherwise Basic.

potato.label: Potato
potato.description: Fastest. Shaders stay off. Sodium uses FAST leaves and weather, a short view distance, and simple clouds. Ships hide spray and foam.

lite.label: Lite
lite.description: Light. Complementary on its Low profile. Sodium stays modest. Ships run at half particles.

normal.label: Normal
normal.description: Balanced. Complementary on its Medium profile. Ocean extras are welcome. Ships use the defaults Arnold ships.

ultra.label: Ultra
ultra.description: Heaviest. Complementary on its High profile. Extra ship particles when Arnold sends those values.
